_about: Speed budgets for the CI fixture: 5,000 generated tracks (cargo run -p pm-library --example big_library -- <dir> 5000), a debug pm-node, tools/ui-perf.js. Measured 2026-10-21 on the dev machine: pages ready in 55-180 ms, search 7-9 ms on the node, first scan 2.3 s, rescan 0.18 s. The budgets leave room for a slower CI machine and fail when a page or search gets much slower; sizes (JSON, DOM nodes) do not depend on the machine and catch a list that loads or draws everything again.
